facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks like UniCredit offer foreign-currency current accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Open a partita IVA with the Agenzia delle Entrate; INPS contributions are separate.
facts.L2_tax_id: A tax identification number used in all dealings with public administration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 23–43% IRPEF, plus regional and municipal surcharges.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 22% VAT; flat-rate (forfettario) sole traders under €85,000 don't charge VAT.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: Regime forfettario: 15% flat tax up to €85,000, or 5% for new activities.

watch_out.text: Passing €100,000 in a year ends the flat-rate regime immediately.
